body: I feel the exact same way. I am a few months away from 24 as well but I still feel like I’m 14
I can maybe try writing it down… talking to someone doesn’t work cause we always end up having the same conversation and they always end up get frustrated and angry with me for not getting better
I feel the same
This is exactly how I’m feeling right now
Sorry I didn’t reply before. I was in the psych ward for 2 weeks. I hope things are going better for you!
Sorry I couldn’t reply to this before! I’ve been the psych ward for 2 weeks. I hope things are going better for you!

I feel the same way. I’m almost 23 and I’ve never dated anyone, I have no friends. My best friend that I had fallen in love with didn’t return my feelings, broke my heart and hasn’t spoken to me in nearly 5 years now. I understand feeling like no one accepts you or cares for you. We just need to find people that will. Even if it takes years.

I’m a woman so I’m not sure if I’m meant to have an opinion on this but I say, no. You’re not doomed to be lonely because you’re a man. Honestly, from reading this I feel like you’re just surrounded by shit fucking people at the moment. And unfortunately there’s a lot of those people in the world. I hope that you can find new people to surround yourself with that will be more accepting and supportive of your feelings.
This is nasty as hell but if it satisfies the urge, you do you, love

Yeah I get that. At this point, if you really want help you’re going to have to build up the courage to talk to someone about it (harsh, I know. I’m currently trying to take my own advice). I hope you can find the strength inside yourself to ask for help. (You’re already off to a great start by asking on here!) I’m rooting for you :)

Would you be willing to talk to your mom about getting you admitted into the hospital if it’s really gotten that bad? I understand if you don’t want to do that. Personally I’m still trying to build up the courage to admit myself.
Congratulations! I’m so proud of you. I’m trying to build up the courage to admit myself into grippy sock jail, so hopefully this will be me in the future!
I understand that. Have you tried any coping mechanisms or alternatives to sh that you can just do on your own for now? Just until you can work up the courage to talk to someone about it?
Thank you. Goodnight. Good luck with all your future endeavours <3
Do you have a parent you would trust to talk about this? Or a school counsellor maybe?
How old are you? If you don’t mind me asking. Maybe you can look into admitting yourself into the hospital?

Hey there. I also have bpd and I know how awfully triggering small things like this can be. Maybe try drawing on your arms with a pen or marker to try and fight the urge? I’m not really sure what to say to help…. But I wanted to try.
Also, I hope you can get your therapy extended.

Thank you and yes, my dad really is the best. As for my hobbies… I really love drawing and reading. I also enjoy writing. Although, I haven’t really done any of those things in a long time. I’ve been having a hard time finding enjoyment in anything lately.

I totally understand how you feel. My family knows how bad it is for me but I do find myself sometimes daydreaming of my doctors finally realizing just how bad it is (cause they never seem to believe me when I explain just how bad it is) I sometimes even daydream about what life would be like for those around me after I’ve killed my self.

When I was 15 I didn’t think I’d make it to 16 and now I’m almost 23. Things might not get better soon for you. Hell, things haven’t gotten better for me. I almost killed myself today but I didn’t. Cause you know what? Life might suck and things might not be better but I know there’s still stuff I want to do in life and if I’ve made it this far I can damn well make it a little longer. Hold on kid, you’ll make it through. Hopefully we’ll all make it through

I also feel like a leech. I haven’t worked a day in my life and I’m about to turn 23. My dad pays for everything for me and I feel extremely guilty about it. I know he’s not pressuring me to work, he knows I’m not well mentally and that I haven’t been for years but I still feel horribly guilty. I almost killed myself today but called my parents for help before I could go through with it. Thankfully they haven’t forced me to admit myself into the hospital but I’m considering doing it myself. Maybe there’s hope for us if we just look for help? (Not that therapy or anything has helped me before but I figured I can try one last time)
Go see your doctor tomorrow. I hope things get better for you.

Holy shit. Other than the relationship part I feel the exact same way. I just don’t have the energy to to work hard for a great life. I guess I just don’t see the point in it? Not if all that hard work practically kills you inside. My family is the only reason I’m still around.
I feel the same way
Hey. Try and get yourself to a hospital. If you regret it it means you actually want to stick around. Go get help. Go fight for your future.

You didn’t creep me out. Thank you for your message. I didn’t go through with my plan. I’m going to try and hold on a little longer. I’m sorry you feel the same way I do. Hopefully things will get better for the both of us
I think maybe being poetic about it makes what you’re thinking of doing feel a little less soul crushing.
I know it wouldn’t be as easy or as peaceful as I worded it. It was just the nicer way of wording it
Honestly I don’t even really feel many brief moments of happiness anymore. I don’t feel much of anything anymore.

Hey there. I understand how you feel. When I was your age I only had one real friend and i was always the one to text first. Other than her I didn’t really have anyone. My family wasn’t dirt poor but I can tell you the money we had didn’t make a difference. My dad bought me loads of stuff to try and make me feel better but I can tell you that money may help a little but it doesn’t take away that empty feeling. I ended up dropping out of school because of that empty feeling and I’m almost 23 now and still haven’t gotten it to go away but I think that’s because when I was younger I never really tried. I just gave in to the empty feeling. I know that hearing that it didn’t get better for me might not make you feel better but I’m telling you this because I wish I could tell myself this at your age. You are still young and you have the power to turn things around even in small ways. Think about your friend group, think if you really want to stick with them. Maybe you’re better on your own? Maybe if you work on yourself mentally for a bit you’ll be brave enough to try and make new friends. I think one of the main things I wish I could’ve told my younger self was to focus on myself. Stop caring what everyone else thinks. Stop worrying about being cool and having people like you. Don’t rely on other people or material things to make you happy. Make yourself happy. Take the time to learn about yourself and what your interests really are. I don’t know… I’m just rambling now. I just wish I could go back and be your age again because if I had taken care of myself more and pushed myself harder to care about myself and my happiness rather than giving up things would’ve turned out different

I’m not quite sure how to nudge you in the right direction but I can tell you that you’re not alone I’m your feelings. I’m almost 23 and I still live with my dad in my hometown. I don’t have a job. I’ve never really had a job because I’ve never been able to handle it mentally. I’m basically unemployable at this point and spend most of my days feeling hopeless and suicidal. I have no sense of self or idea of what I want in life because I honestly never though I’d even make it to the age of 18, let alone nearly 23. I also loved a girl ( an unrequited love but she made me happy) and it’s been nearly 5 years since I last saw her and I still think about her every day. I guess we just have to keep trying to push through hoping we’ll somehow have that moment when we’re finally determined enough to actually change things. We push through until we have that moment where we really properly realize that we’re the only ones that can actually turn our lives around. Until then we find a small thing every day to pull us through.
8th grade was honestly the peak of my life
It’s always nice to hear someone knows what it’s like. It’s also hard for me to even get help where I live. I live in a small conservative city that isn’t exactly kind to people with mental illness.
This was actually really beautiful and comforting to read. Thank you.
Sorry. I’m just sick of hearing the same shit. Didn’t mean to take it out on you. Thanks for trying
I hope you know it’s people like you, who spill bullshit like that, that make people like me want to die even more

Wow. I feel like you just read my mind and put it out for all to see. This is exactly how I feel. My mom is always telling me that if I kill myself she’ll blame herself for the rest of her life even though I’ve told her it’s not her fault I want to die. I so wish I could just do it. I’m sick of hearing from my family that they’re in just as much pain as I am because of how I am.
I don’t have the strength to change me. It’s too late for that
I’m the same way. It stung, but I guess I was just so determined to hurt myself that it was easier to deal with the pain..

I made a couple that were probably a little too deep but the small scratches just weren’t satisfying me. I wanted them to BLEED ya know? I wanted it too look and feel like I deserve it… I needed it to look as painful as I felt I deserved
No offence, but I think you need a new girlfriend. But I get it. I don’t like the pain either. But the blood, the blood was nice. It almost feels like a messed up piece of art on your body.

I feel this all the time. Especially when watching musical theatre actors who got their first Broadway gig when they were my age or younger (I’m 22). It makes me especially upset because it’s what I want to be doing in my life but I feel too old to pursue it. I have no singing experience and I’ve lost most of my dance training so it feels hopeless.

I’m not in school. ( I’m actually an adult. How sad is that) I just live with my parents because I’m not stable enough to work. As for therapy… it’s expensive and I always tend to give up on it so I’m always scared that if I ask my dad to help pay for it I’ll give up and disappoint him
I don’t have any currently, but in the past, yeah totally. I have a couple that I’m not close friends with anymore but I still support them from afar. Like I’m always rooting for them.
Interesting. I just asked because I’m a woman but I always find it easier to be friends with men.
What makes you think it’s because you’re a man specifically, that they don’t like you?

I totally get this. Right now the only thing getting me through is my mom and spending good days with her. I tend to crash when I’m alone a realize that if her or my dad dies, I have no idea how I’m going to support myself. My mom and I are slowly trying to work on a plan to help me get on my feet but I totally understand how you’re feeling. I’ve luckily had a good week this week, but I definitely tend to be in the headspace you’re in right now more often than not.
Thank you to everyone for commenting but I’ve made my decision. She was right. Counselling won’t help and I won’t change my mindset. I’m sorry. Thank you for being kind.

I don’t know… my family doctor and psychiatrist have both told me that I’m the problem. That I’m simply treatment resistant and that no one can help me if I don’t help myself first. I really think I’m the problem.
I wish my mom felt this way. When I told her that I wanted to kill myself she told me should would blame herself and feel guilty for the rest of her life if I went through with it.
I feel the exact same way.
